features.name: Sound suppressor, detachable folding stock, integrated smartgun and gas-vent system
Published illustration shows a compact receiver and magazine extending below the grip

Assigned sole reviewer inspected actual native and 2048 masks, detailed/clay teal composites and paired overlay against Core printed308/PDF310 own labeled artwork. Suppressor, receiver faces and central strap/control, lower block, grip magazine, thin folding-stock rod, rear hinge and trigger/guard preserved. Trigger opening remains clear; open exterior around free-ended stock remains clear. Smooth clay fills screws, grip ribs/stippling and microtexture; broad receiver-face insets match source major face boundaries and are retained, without claiming removable covers. No broad pale halo or detached islands. Independent traces and common transform preserve framing without force alignment. Black metal finish/wear in detail are artistic; source is monochrome. Reference-only approval.
